findings.summary: The plan endpoint and response field are not established by the cited repository evidence; the brief asks the planner to implement an internal API contract that the loop's stubs cannot verify.
findings.evidence: The brief names GET https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/user and copilot_plan at docs/briefs/B20261126-1818-b46-i153-copilot-model-ids.loop-brief.md:98-103, but its binding reference at line 85 points to docs/design-notes/copilot-cli-experiments.md:623-643, which documents only GET https://api.githubcopilot.com/models. A repository search found no copilot_internal/user or copilot_plan outside this brief, and M4 says the design note will gain the plan evidence (brief line 208).
findings.fix: Operator: confirm the exact endpoint and copilot_plan field from an account observation, and preferably name or include that evidence in a repository binding reference before marking the brief ready; otherwise revise M1 to a plan source the cited evidence supports.

findings.summary: The no-login case names the wrong doctor row.
findings.evidence: The brief says the existing `copilot` row reports the missing login at docs/briefs/B20261126-1818-b46-i153-copilot-model-ids.loop-brief.md:174-175. Current code creates `copilot` for the CLI check, then a separate `copilot login` row for the token check at internal/cli/doctor.go:510-517; doctor tests assert that row at internal/cli/doctor_copilot_test.go:177-206.
findings.fix: Change the M2 wording and any matching contract/gate expectation from `copilot` to `copilot login`; keep the specified absence of the `copilot models` row.

findings.summary: The prospective agent/model pair is not defined consistently with configuration precedence, and removal is ambiguous.
findings.evidence: M2 says the single-key check uses the agent value `after the write` and never checks removal at docs/briefs/B20261126-1818-b46-i153-copilot-model-ids.loop-brief.md:145-156. M3 instead says a flag-written agent/model beats the resolved value at lines 192-200, while C-1 says environment, local, shared and default resolution decides the effective value (docs/domain/domain-model.md:268-271). The brief does not say whether `--kinds --model ''` checks the resulting default alias or is exempt, nor whether a higher-precedence environment override makes the candidate pair non-Copilot.
findings.fix: Define validation from the prospective fully resolved configuration after all named changes, respecting C-1; state explicitly that removals first expose the next source/default, and then apply or skip M2 according to that effective pair. Add a gate for a local or environment override and for `--model ''`.

decisions: B46 treats today's seven session-kind key table as the complete --kinds vocabulary; this is reasonable, but the operator should confirm it is intentional.
M1 prints the plan first and models in strings/id order; I agree, and the wording should remain literal in gates.
B46 relies on GET https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/user and copilot_plan; operator confirmation is required by the first finding.
